title.zh: 红茶甘纳许栗子奶油蛋糕
title.en: Black Tea Ganache & Chestnut Cream Layer Cake

summary.zh: 28 × 28 cm 蛋糕片切三片叠层 · 本次成品与烘烤记录
summary.en: A 28 × 28 cm cake sheet, cut into three layers · actual bake and finished cake

detail.en: All added to the egg whites

title.zh: 红茶白巧克力甘纳许奶油
title.en: Black tea white chocolate whipped ganache

amount.en: About 80 g; use 60 g after straining

detail.zh: 实际配方只使用过滤后的 60 g
detail.en: Only the 60 g strained cream goes into the ganache

steps.zh: 蛋糕片：蛋黄与红茶牛奶、植物油混合，筛入低筋面粉，加入红茶碎；细砂糖 45 g 全部用于打发蛋白，再与蛋黄糊混合。铺入 28 × 28 cm 烤盘。
steps.en: Cake sheet: Mix yolks with the black tea milk and oil, sift in the cake flour, and add ground tea. Whip the whites with all 45 g sugar, then fold into the yolk batter. Spread in a 28 × 28 cm pan.

steps.zh: 本次实际烘烤：150°C（302°F）30 分钟。放凉后切成三片，叠成蛋糕。
steps.en: Actual bake: 150°C (302°F) for 30 minutes. Cool, cut into three pieces, and stack as a layer cake.

steps.zh: 甘纳许：用约 80 g 淡奶油浸泡红茶 8–10 分钟，过滤并称取 60 g 红茶奶油；与白巧克力乳化后冷藏。次日加入 170 g 冷淡奶油，打发。无需另加糖。
steps.en: Ganache: Steep the tea in about 80 g cream for 8–10 minutes, strain, and weigh out 60 g infused cream. Emulsify with white chocolate and chill. The next day, add 170 g cold cream and whip. No extra sugar.

steps.zh: 栗子奶油：把有糖香草栗子泥和 150 g 淡奶油一起打发，用于夹层和装饰。
steps.en: Chestnut cream: Whip sweetened vanilla chestnut purée with 150 g cream for filling and decoration.

notes.zh: 这次原想做蛋糕卷，卷制中开裂，改切三片叠层。使用美式燃气烤箱下层，烤箱里还放了另一只烤盘；成品底面偏硬、光滑。下次若重试蛋糕卷，优先观察实际炉温、烤架位置和出炉状态。
notes.en: This started as a Swiss roll, but cracked while rolling, so the sheet was cut and stacked in three layers. It baked on a lower rack in a gas oven with another tray inside; the bottom was hard and smooth. For another roll attempt, check the actual oven temperature, rack position, and doneness.

notes.zh: 照片为这次三层叠片、栗子奶油裱面的成品。表面栗子块的用量没有记录。
notes.en: The photo shows the finished three-layer cake with piped chestnut cream. The amount of chestnut pieces on top was not recorded.
